checks.descripcion: src/logic.js es un módulo ES válido
El código usa const y let, nunca var
src/logic.js define las funciones con arrow functions, sin la palabra function

checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; assert.equal(l.formatHeader({ name: 'Sala Norte', code: 'SN-7' }), 'Sala Norte (SN-7)');"

checks.descripcion: formatLocation usa valores por defecto y respeta la planta 0
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; assert.equal(l.formatLocation({ location: { room: 'Sala A', floor: 0 } }), 'Sala A · planta 0'); assert.equal(l.formatLocation({}), 'Sin ubicación · planta -'); assert.equal(l.formatLocation({ location: { floor: 3 } }), 'Sin ubicación · planta 3');"

cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; const items = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => ({ name: 'e' + n, level: n })); assert.equal(l.visibleItems(items, false).length, 3); assert.equal(l.visibleItems(items, false)[0].name, 'e1'); assert.equal(l.visibleItems(items, true).length, 5); assert.equal(l.visibleItems(items.slice(0, 2), false).length, 2);"

checks.descripcion: averageLevel calcula la media redondeada y 0 sin elementos
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; assert.equal(l.averageLevel([{ level: 90 }, { level: 75 }]), 83); assert.equal(l.averageLevel([{ level: 10 }]), 10); assert.equal(l.averageLevel([]), 0);"

checks.descripcion: countAbove cuenta los elementos con nivel igual o mayor
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; const items = [{ level: 90 }, { level: 80 }, { level: 79 }]; assert.equal(l.countAbove(items, 80), 2); assert.equal(l.countAbove(items, 95), 0); assert.equal(l.countAbove([], 10), 0);"

checks.descripcion: buildSummary devuelve las 4 líneas del resumen
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; const s = l.buildSummary({ name: 'Sala Norte', code: 'SN-7', description: 'Mapas', location: { room: 'Ala B', floor: 1 }, items: [{ level: 50 }, { level: 70 }] }); assert.deepEqual(s.split('\\n'), ['Sala Norte (SN-7)', 'Mapas', 'Ala B · planta 1', 'Elementos: 2 · nivel medio 60%']); assert.deepEqual(l.buildSummary({ name: 'X', code: 'Y' }).split('\\n'), ['X (Y)', 'Sin descripción', 'Sin ubicación · planta -', 'Elementos: 0 · nivel medio 0%']);"

checks.descripcion: nextTheme alterna entre light y dark
checks.cmd: cd {proyecto} && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as l from './src/logic.js'; assert.equal(l.nextTheme('light'), 'dark'); assert.equal(l.nextTheme('dark'), 'light'); assert.equal(l.nextTheme(undefined), 'dark');"
